title: Question 18
passage:
My pass for the swimming pool is on my old phone, but the phone won't turn on.
A. Your pass is good through the end of the month. B. The front desk can look you up by name. C. The phone charging station is past the entry gate.
passageZh:
我的游泳池通行證在舊手機裡，但那支手機開不了機。
A. 你的通行證月底前都有效。
B. 櫃台可以用姓名查你的資料。
C. 手機充電站在入口閘門裡面。
